title: Department of Health probes private hospital after patient’s ovaries removed by mistake
text:
Department of Health probes private hospital after patient’s ovaries removed by mistake Global Voices City Vibe Trending Hong Kong Business International Racing Lifestyle Showbiz Sport Opinion Games ePaper Global Voices HK+GBA Mega Events & Fairs Investments Study in HK & Tech Canadian Voices City Vibe People ArtCan Trending Social Buzz Must Read Hong Kong News Explorer Politics Health Education Business Finance Property Innovation ESG International China World Racing Hong Kong Racing World Racing Analysis Racecourse Entertainment Lifestyle Arts & Culture Wellness Food & Wine Leisure Showbiz Entertainment Gossip Screen & Music Sport Sports Updates Football Basketball Tennis Opinion Editorial Insights Games Crossword HONG KONG NEWS Department of Health probes private hospital after patient’s ovaries removed by mistake
 NEWS 17-11-2026 13:56 HKT (File photo) The Department of Health has received reports of two sentinel events at private medical institutions in September, including an incident where a 45-year-old patient had her bilateral ovaries inadvertently removed during surgery at a private hospital.
 ADVERTISEMENT SCROLL TO CONTINUE WITH CONTENT The department received a report from the hospital on September 13. The patient’s ovaries were mistakenly removed during laparoscopic hysterectomy and bilateral salpingectomy surgery. She is now in stable condition. 
 The department said it found no evidence that the hospital had breached applicable requirements on premises, staffing or equipment under the relevant code of practice in connection with the incident.
 In the other case, a 27-year-old woman was misidentified as another patient at a day procedure center and underwent dental scaling. She is also in stable condition.
 The department said it followed up immediately after receiving the notifications and required the institutions involved to submit investigation reports within four weeks. It has received the reports and completed its investigations into both incidents.
 The institutions have implemented corrective measures, and the department will continue to monitor their implementation.
